items.subject: Zhuge Liang, Three Kingdoms strategist, a calm scholar in his thirties, long black hair tied with a plain cloth band, light jade-green robe with wide sleeves, holding a feather fan, serene thoughtful expression
Nezha, Chinese mythology youth deity, a confident teenage warrior, hair in two buns, red sash and light armor over a short robe, holding a spear, energetic stance, faint flame motif on the sleeves
Li Bai, Tang dynasty poet, a lean wandering swordsman in his forties, loose white robe with ink-wash stains, wine gourd at the waist, sword on the back, relaxed half-smile, wind-blown sleeves
An ancient stone pagoda on a cliff above a sea of clouds, narrow steps winding upward, distant mountain peaks, early morning light, no characters
